text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, Rudolf? What do you think aboutsleeping
on the floor on a futon?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well we do have some available inthe
dorms. Now that I think about it, thelinen
storage room could use some moreventilation for
hygienic purposes.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so nothing about being "floored" bythe
health benefits? Too bad.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about that. Anyways, Prez.Take a
look at this cell phone.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been on silent mode for awhile
now.It's been ringing, but I keepignoring it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guh. Nothing about how I'm "phoning itin" with
my connections? This might betrickier than I
thought...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I have to go now. I have ameeting with
Teio, so I mustn't... Heh. Imustn't "overstay, yo."
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Did Teio just score without even beinghere?
Well, our game to see who can gether to say a
pun first ends in a draw.We'll try again next time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aww, Teio's just too good! But nexttime, I'll win
this! Then I'll tell Teio allabout it!
